stimulus: (a) There are many stars in the sky ⎯⎯. (b) Rukab will swim after ⎯⎯. (c) A graveyard is the place ⎯⎯. (d) ⎯⎯ cannot be blotted. (e) The answer that he ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) There are as many stars in the sky but the moon is only one. (b) Rukab will swim after he completes his lesson. (c) A graveyard is the place where the dead bodies are buried. (d) What is lotted cannot be blotted. (e) The answer that he gave was absolutely correct.
